verdict.rationale: Windmill documents an official CLI, `wmill`, for working with Windmill instances from the terminal. The docs also describe CLI deployments from a Git repository, and a probe confirmed the official CLI docs page. Missing for 10: detailed evidence of CLI command coverage or AI-native/agent-oriented CLI workflows (e.g., machine-readable output), and independent hands-on corroboration of CLI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The Windmill CLI, `wmill` allows you to interact with Windmill instances right from your terminal.
as well as CLI deployments from a Git repository
